author: codex

patch.value: Add tag-aware fallback dates for release-gated changelogs

GitHub issue #120: a release-gated package with no tag falls back to the current UTC date, so changelog checks drift daily; the existing --date override then masks a real tag date once publication occurs. Add a fallback-only date contract, optionally derived from CalVer, whose value is ignored whenever an authoritative tag timestamp exists.

A fallback date is used only when no release tag resolves; an eventual tag timestamp always wins; CalVer-derived fallback behavior is explicit and tested; CLI, SDK extension flags, docs, 100/100/100 coverage, release checks, and installed-package acceptance pass.

Untagged releases generate stable, validated fallback dates without an unconditional override; a later tag automatically becomes authoritative and bypasses unused fallback-value validation.

Added --date-fallback and --date-from-version to standalone generate, SDK generate, and SDK export. Existing tag timestamps remain authoritative and bypass fallback-value validation; mutually exclusive fallback flags fail closed on every invocation, while an invalid CalVer fallback fails closed only when no tag resolves and the fallback would be consumed.
